Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning compliance with inspections of child care facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to compliance with inspections of child carefacilities; and adding a new section to chapter 43.215 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.215 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall consult with a city or county enforcementofficial prior to requiring any alterations of a family home child carefacility due to inconsistencies with requirements in chapter 19.27 RCW. (2) The department's consultation with the city or countyenforcement official shall be limited to licensed child care space. (3) The department may not modify, suspend, or revoke child carelicense or business activities while the department is waiting forappropriate agency consultations, unless there is imminent danger forchildren or staff.
